name: 小鸊鷉

iucn.assessmentNote: 全球LC；香港常見留鳥，邊緣濕地有退縮

illustrationTaxon: Tachybaptus ruficollis adult in breeding plumage; main image and diagnostic features

similarSpecies.distinction: 黑頸鸊鷉體型相若或稍大，頭較大、額冠較陡、喙較窄尖、身形較修長且眼虹膜紅色；頸側與脅部多白，頭部深色範圍較廣。小鸊鷉較矮圓，成鳥全年深色頭冠及淡色眼。
鳳頭鸊鷉大得多（46–61 cm），頸長、身體修長低浮，冬羽眼前至前頸白、冠及眼至喙深色，喙長而纖細偏淡；小鸊鷉只有25–29 cm，圓頭短鈍喙、身形短圓。

featureNotes: 成鳥全年保有深色頭冠與淡色眼，頭部相對圓大
繁殖羽橙褐頰及頸側醒目，喙基有淡黃嘴角斑
短而鈍的喙與矮圓體型，和大型長頸鸊鷉易區分
身體低浮於淡水面，後部羽毛蓬鬆，常潛水覓食

sources.use: Full HKBWS account read: 25–29 cm; compact grebe with round head, short blunt pale-tipped bill, large feet, fluffy rear and dark crown/pale eyes year-round in adults. Non-breeding brown upperparts, grey-buff sides, whitish underparts, mostly pale orange-yellow bill with dark upper ridge and dusky tip; breeding plumage orange-brown cheeks/neck, grey-brown upperparts, buff flanks and underbody, white undertail coverts, pale yellow gape mark and mostly dark bill; juveniles striped black/white head with pink bill. Hong Kong Category I, common in open freshwater wetlands in northwest New Territories, with marginal wetland decline; IUCN LC, trend decreasing. Range broad across Europe, Africa, Asia and parts of Indonesia.

Full HKBWS Black-necked Grebe account read: winter first-year 28–34 cm, similar/slightly larger than Little Grebe but larger head, steeper crown, narrower pointed bill, less dumpy shape, red iris and white neck-sides/flanks contrasting darker head/upperparts. Rare winter visitor in Hong Kong; IUCN LC, trend unknown.

Full HKBWS Great Crested Grebe account read: 46–61 cm, much larger, long-bodied/long-necked, long slender largely pale bill; winter adult has white face to above eye and fore-neck, dark crown and dark line from eye to bill. Common winter visitor in Deep Bay; IUCN LC, trend unknown.
Cornell eBird/Merlin species account for cross-checking adult Little Grebe identification.
